name: List orders
description: List orders Lists all Climate order objects. GET /v1/climate/orders
context:
GET /v1/climate/orders
Lists all Climate order objects. The orders are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recently created orders appearing first.
Optional: ending_before (query) — A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.; expand (query) — Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.; limit (query) — A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.; starting_after (query) — A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.; body (body)

name: Create an order
description: Create an order Creates a Climate order object for a given Climate product. POST /v1/climate/orders
context:
POST /v1/climate/orders
Creates a Climate order object for a given Climate product. The order will be processed immediately after creation and payment will be deducted your Stripe balance.
Required: body (body)

name: Update an order
description: Update an order Updates the specified order by setting the values of the parameters passed. POST /v1/climate/orders/{order}
context:
POST /v1/climate/orders/{order}
Updates the specified order by setting the values of the parameters passed.
Required: order (path) — Unique identifier of the order.
Optional: body (body)

name: Cancel an order
description: Cancel an order Cancels a Climate order. POST /v1/climate/orders/{order}/cancel
context:
POST /v1/climate/orders/{order}/cancel
Cancels a Climate order. You can cancel an order within 24 hours of creation. Stripe refunds the reservation amount_subtotal , but not the amount_fees for user-triggered cancellations. Frontier might cancel reservations if suppliers fail to deliver. If Frontier cancels the reservation, Stripe provides 90 days advance notice and refunds the amount_total .
Required: order (path) — Unique identifier of the order.
Optional: body (body)
